## What's new

- Get Homebrew (MENU > ROM Management): new games from itch.io for NES, Master System, Game Boy, Genesis, TurboGrafx-16, Game Gear, SNES, Game Boy Color and Game Boy Advance. Free ones, and ones you bought with your own itch.io API key (typed on the Brick or pasted in ChaOS Transfer). Each goes onto its shelf with its cover as box art; a game already on the card is found by its bytes and not kept twice.
- Multi-Disc Games: discs copied in loose are found after ChaOS Transfer sends anything and once a week, and combined into one game (a folder with an .m3u), its save, states, box art and records with it. Also in ROM Management.
- The heading of RomM's, PortMaster's and Get Homebrew's screens sits in the middle of its band.

---

ChaOS 2.5.0 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v2.5.0-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.2.0](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.2.0) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v2.5.0-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
